criterion_results.rationale: The fixed-SHA test run passed all 17 discovered tests, including baseline behavior and deterministic API-level cancellation cases.
The unchanged reproducer exited successfully and reported an accepted cancellation that remained cancelled with no result after worker exit.
TaskService.cancel handles queued and running tasks under the existing lock, sets status to cancelled, sets the task's existing cancellation event, and then returns True.
Both Exception and success publication branches check for running status and publish terminal fields within the same existing lock, so accepted cancellation cannot be overwritten.
The new tests drive create, start, cancel, and get through TaskAPI; direct TaskService use is limited to bounded joins for observation and cleanup.

Running-task tests use Events and bounded waits, register cleanup immediately after start, release blocked workers during cleanup, use bounded joins, and assert recorded wait outcomes in the test thread without sleep-based scheduling.
The B01 commit changes only task_service.py and the newly added tests/test_cancellation.py.
The complete fixed-SHA suite passed, including B01 behavior, nested-result isolation through get and cancel responses, and explicit deepcopy-failure propagation.
The unchanged reproducer passed at the reviewed SHA, confirming that B02 preserves cancellation finality.
TaskService.snapshot captures id, status, result, and error under _lock, releases the lock, then deep-copies the captured result.
TaskService.snapshot does not catch deepcopy failures, and TaskAPI.get and TaskAPI.cancel do not add a fallback, so copy exceptions propagate without returning an aliased result.
README.md describes the original defect in the past tense, states that the unchanged reproducer now passes, and retains the cooperative-thread, seeded-defect, and no-company-material disclosures.
README.md documents standard-library deepcopy semantics, loss of result identity across snapshots, propagation of copy failures, and the limits of user-defined copy hooks.
The B02 commit changes only README.md, task_service.py, and tests/test_cancellation.py.
